g.text: If a partial solution is found
Helps find all or some valid solutions
Explore child nodes one by one
If a path cannot find a valid answer, stop
and go back to try another path
Why its better than brute force?
- Try every possible path from the
entrance until you eventually reach the
- Even dead ends are explored completely
before moving to the next path
- If you hit a wall or a dead end,
immediately go back to previous turn and
- avoid wasting time exploring the paths
